opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households who are not eligible for government tuition fee support, ordinarily resident in Scotland, and enrolled on an undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher‑education institution.
opportunities.summary: Grants cover tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students in Scotland up to £1,820 per year.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Graduates from low‑income Scottish households who are undertaking a full‑time master's programme.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 per year to support postgraduate master's study for eligible graduates.
